messages.subject: [R-SIG-Win] When can we expect further versions of R for Windows on ARM?
messages.subject_clean: When can we expect further versions of R for Windows on ARM?
messages.body_plain:
Dear All,

As far as I am aware, Tomas Kalibera led the development of R for Windows on ARM machines. His much too early passing stopped the development of this version of R. Because I own a Snapdragon Elite X based system, I am very interested on continuation of work for this architecture. The last version available is R-4.5.3. When can we expect further versions of R for Windows on ARM systems?

I hope my question will not be considered as spam or anything like this. I looked at FAQ pages and hadn't seen any information on this. I know that my issue is very specific and quite niche.

Thank you,

Krzysztof


--
